instruction: Open Apple Notes and move the note "Weekly Goals" from the "Notes" folder to the "Study" folder.

parameters.note_body: Move this note to the study folder.

reference_command:
note_index=$(memo notes | awk '/^[0-9]+\./ { idx=$1; sub(/\./, "", idx); line=$0; sub(/^[0-9]+\. /, "", line); n=split(line, parts, " - "); title=parts[n]; if (title == "Weekly Goals") { print idx; exit } }')
if [ -z "$note_index" ]; then
  echo "Note not found: Weekly Goals"
  exit 1
fi
printf '%s\n%s\n' "$note_index" "Study" | memo notes --move
